text: Bhai, escalation raise karne se kya hoga? Wohi generic email ya ticket ban jayega aur koi fayda nahi hoga. Mujhe ek senior team wale ko bolo jo seedha courier wale ko phone karke pata kare ki woh kahan hai aur mera jacket aaj raat tak kyon nahi pahuncha. Mujhe abhi call back chahiye kisi senior se, bas yeh ticket-shicket wala khel mat khelo yaar.
